answer_text:
Here is a comprehensive list of major **Sherlock Holmes Movies**, organized by era:

---

## 🎩 Sherlock Holmes Movies – Complete List

---

### 🎞️ Silent Era (1900–1929)
Early films like *Sherlock Holmes Baffled* (1900) and *A Study in Scarlet* (1914) introduced Holmes to cinema.

| Year | Title | Star |
|------|-------|------|
| 1900 | Sherlock Holmes Baffled | Unknown |
| 1905 | Adventures of Sherlock Holmes; or, Held for Ransom | — |
| 1914 | A Study in Scarlet | James Bragington |
| 1916 | Sherlock Holmes | William Gillette |
| 1922 | Sherlock Holmes | John Barrymore |
| 1929 | The Return of Sherlock Holmes | Clive Brook |

John Barrymore played the role in a 1922 movie entitled *Sherlock Holmes*, with Roland Young as Watson and William Powell in his first screen appearance. This Goldwyn film is the first Holmes movie made with high production values and a major star.

---

### 🔍 Early Talkies Era (1929–1937)
Arthur Wontner's series and films like *The Speckled Band* (1931) brought Holmes to the sound era, blending fidelity to the source material with modernized elements.

| Year | Title | Star |
|------|-------|------|
| 1929 | The Return of Sherlock Holmes | Clive Brook |
| 1931 | The Speckled Band | Raymond Massey |
| 1931 | The Sleeping Cardinal | Arthur Wontner |
| 1932 | Sherlock Holmes | Clive Brook |
| 1933 | A Study in Scarlet | Reginald Owen |
| 1937 | Silver Blaze | Arthur Wontner |

In 1931, Raymond Massey played Sherlock Holmes in his screen debut, *The Speckled Band*, while Arthur Wontner played Holmes in five British films from 1931 to 1937.

---

### 🎬 Basil Rathbone Era (1939–1946)
A series of fourteen films based on Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's Sherlock Holmes stories was released between 1939 and 1946; British actors Basil Rathbone and Nigel Bruce played Holmes and Dr. John Watson. The first two films were produced by 20th Century Fox. Universal Pictures then acquired the rights and produced a further twelve films.

| Year | Title |
|------|-------|
| 1939 | The Hound of the Baskervilles |
| 1939 | The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes |
| 1942 | Sherlock Holmes and the Voice of Terror |
| 1942 | Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon |
| 1943 | Sherlock Holmes in Washington |
| 1943 | Sherlock Holmes Faces Death |
| 1944 | The Spider Woman |
| 1944 | The Scarlet Claw |
| 1944 | The Pearl of Death |
| 1945 | The House of Fear |
| 1945 | The Woman in Green |
| 1945 | Pursuit to Algiers |
| 1946 | Terror by Night |
| 1946 | Dressed to Kill |

Basil Rathbone holds the record for portraying Sherlock Holmes in the most feature-length films, starring in 14 movies from 1939 to 1946. His portrayal is considered definitive by many fans.

---

### 🧪 Mid-Century & Hammer Films (1958–1970)

| Year | Title | Star |
|------|-------|------|
| 1959 | The Hound of the Baskervilles | Peter Cushing |
| 1970 | The Private Life of Sherlock Holmes | Robert Stephens |

When a nobleman is threatened by a family curse on his newly inherited estate, detective Sherlock Holmes is hired to investigate, in the 1959 film directed by Terence Fisher, starring Peter Cushing and Christopher Lee.

---

### 🎭 Comedy & Revisionist Era (1975–1988)

| Year | Title | Star |
|------|-------|------|
| 1975 | The Adventure of Sherlock Holmes' Smarter Brother | Gene Wilder |
| 1976 | The Seven-Per-Cent Solution | Nicol Williamson |
| 1985 | Young Sherlock Holmes | Nicholas Rowe |
| 1986 | The Great Mouse Detective *(animated)* | Basil (voice) |
| 1988 | Without a Clue | Michael Caine |

*Young Sherlock Holmes* (1985) served as an origin story, *The Great Mouse Detective* (1986) was a Disneyfication, and *Without a Clue* (1988) featured a case of mistaken identity.

---

### 📺 Christopher Lee Era (1991–1992)

| Year | Title | Star |
|------|-------|------|
| 1991 | Sherlock Holmes and the Leading Lady | Christopher Lee |
| 1991 | Incident at Victoria Falls | Christopher Lee |

The 1991–92 series *Sherlock Holmes the Golden Years* consisted of two TV films, in which Sherlock Holmes (played by Christopher Lee) and Dr. Watson (played by Patrick Macnee) are older adults who continue investigating cases. The two films were *Incident at Victoria Falls* and *Sherlock Holmes and the Leading Lady*.

---

### 🕵️ Modern Era (2009–Present)

| Year | Title | Star | Director |
|------|-------|------|----------|
| 2002 | Case of Evil | James D'Arcy | — |
| 2009 | Sherlock Holmes | Robert Downey Jr. | Guy Ritchie |
| 2011 | Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows | Robert Downey Jr. | Guy Ritchie |
| 2015 | Mr. Holmes | Ian McKellen | Bill Condon |
| 2018 | Holmes & Watson | Will Ferrell | — |
| 2020 | Enola Holmes | Henry Cavill | — |
| 2022 | Enola Holmes 2 | Henry Cavill | — |

*Mr. Holmes* (2015) features an aged, retired Sherlock Holmes dealing with dementia, as he tries to remember his final case. He also befriends a fan, the young son of his housekeeper. It stars Ian McKellen, Laura Linney, and Hiroyuki Sanada.

Robert Downey Jr. won a Golden Globe for his portrayal as a dishevelled bohemian Holmes in the 2009 film. Socially awkward and broodingly erratic, this Holmes is unsurprised by his brilliance but baffled as to why Watson (Jude Law) would want to give up the chase for domesticity.

---

> 🔎 **Fun Fact:** Sherlock Holmes is said to be one of the world's favourite characters for English-language films. The character has been adapted countless times across silent films, classic Hollywood productions, international television, and modern blockbusters!
